objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix with consecutive number (e.g., RL_0001).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be re-checked (default 3 years).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced in the document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas to which the document applies.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the attachment, following the main document's release statuses.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changing an existing released document, created and tracked independently of the document's version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to check and extend document validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a document and archive it, triggering a workflow for approval of the invalidation.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated (archived) document, triggering a workflow to restore the document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with documents in the system, assigned to one or more roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (e.g., Reader, Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users that controls authorization and distribution for documents (e.g., Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: An automated process instance that routes tasks through defined steps (Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow process (e.g., release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signed confirmation by a workflow participant, documented per released version for traceability.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a recipient on the distribution list that they have read and noted a released document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system in which documents can be made visible but not changed.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document (information object) is created in the system by selecting a document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first workflow step (Creator) with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication during the release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the process for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights user creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents editing of the change proposal, marking it as completed and notifying the creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's Valid Until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and start the override workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement of a newly released document version.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding language.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read and write permissions are assigned to user groups or individual users for a document.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted from the system after the archive duration has expired.

o2o.description: A document can have one or more controlled attachments that follow its release cycle.
A document can have one or more additional information objects that are independently published.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within it.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
A request for override is linked to the document to be invalidated.
A request for reactivation references the archived document to be reactivated.
Documents can reference other documents via the References attribute.
Each document type can have one or more templates used when creating new documents.
Each document has a maintained distribution list of user groups and persons for notification and acknowledgement.
A user is assigned to one or more user groups that control authorization and role access.
A distribution list contains user groups whose members receive notifications or acknowledgement requests.
A distribution list can contain individual persons in addition to user groups.
A document can be made visible in specific clients in a multi-client system.
